name: How To Treat Your Neighbor
overview: Scripture clearly commands believers to love their neighbors as themselves, emphasizing this as a central and weighty commandment second only to loving God with all one’s heart, soul, mind, and strength (Mark 12:30-31). This love extends beyond mere kindness to include forgiveness and active goodwill even toward enemies, calling Christians to bless, do good, and pray for those who persecute them (Matthew 5:44; Luke 6:27). The principle of treating others as we would want to be treated encapsulates the law and the prophets, underscoring the biblical foundation for neighborly conduct rooted in grace and selfless love (Matthew 7:12; Leviticus 19:18).
